queries: WITH analysed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref) SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysed_trade_records, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS overall_share FROM analysed_trades GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysed_trade_records, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS overall_share FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind;

WITH analysed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.transreg, r.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS r ON r.tradereg = t.trdref), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM analysed_trades GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, trade_count, trade_count::numeric / SUM(trade_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts ORDER BY tradekind

WITH counts AS (SELECT r.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS r ON r.tradereg = t.trdref GROUP BY r.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts ORDER BY tradekind

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS analysed_trade_records FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, analysed_trade_records, analysed_trade_records::numeric / SUM(analysed_trade_records) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY trader_type;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS analysed_records FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, analysed_records, analysed_records::numeric / SUM(analysed_records) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY trader_type;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS analysed_trade_records FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, analysed_trade_records, analysed_trade_records::numeric / SUM(analysed_trade_records) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY trader_type;

assumptions.assumption: Each trade record is counted once even if it has multiple advanced behaviour records; the schema does not require translink to be unique.

alternatives.interpretation: Count advanced behaviour analysis records, so multiple analyses of one trade count separately.
